name: Beacon
description: Records sessions from Claude Code, Codex and 20+ other agents in the background, then turns the sessions you pick into project memory, but only lessons you approve, which any of those agents can look up.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI with a background recorder, hooks, MCP server and skills

offline_no_account.value: Yes with the Local option; the setup wizard preselects its cloud

plain_files.value: No: a memory.db store; a memory can be written out as a skill file

footprint.value: Small: one Go program plus a local recorder service

claude_code.value: Yes: records sessions; plugin skills save and recall memory

codex.value: Yes: records Codex CLI and app; same skills plugin

claude_chat.value: Partial: records claude.ai chats; recall not documented

claude_cowork.value: Yes: Cowork plugin from its marketplace

chatgpt_chat.value: Partial: records ChatGPT chats; recall not documented

survives_compaction.value: Recall tools usable mid-session; no reload after compaction

uninstall.value: beacon endpoint uninstall removes what it installed

license_cost.value: MIT; free locally; cloud memory is $20 a month (Pro)
